latestIgtvVideos.title: Friday feature of a female founder!
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
@chelseamcsunshine started @sunshinestategoods 
In my home town, Clearwater, Fl. Her “why” is clear. For people who like coastal living, florida, and sunshine, give them better options. We grew up on the beach and never wanted to wear any of the apparel sold in all the local tourist shops. Shirts were scratchy really bad material, designes on the shirts were lame or “cheesy”. She wanted to give not only the locals better options, but the tourists too! Her purpose is to help keep Florida’s wildlife corridor protected, it runs through the middle of the state and is really important for wildlife. She gives a portion of everything she sells to the @fl_wildcorridor fund. My kids and I live in her stuff. So if you’re wanting some good karma, or just some good hats, t-shirts, sunshirts with a sunshine vibe, head over to Chelsea’s instagram and show her some ❤️👊. 
#WomenSupportingWomen

latestIgtvVideos.title: Hell on the Hill (round 7!)
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
Every year for the past 7 years @jesseitzler and I host an endurance charity event in our backyard. Leave it to my husband to turn our super steep hill in our backyard into a physical challenge. Yup… that’s right he took one look at the dreadful hill in our backyard and said, “I know exactly what to do with this. We will create the worlds toughest backyard race.” (I was thinking more slip-n-slide :-) Anyway… 100 laps up and down in under 4hrs for the charity of your choice. Every year we cry. Every year there is so much love, grit and camaraderie on that hill. Everyone stands up first and says why they are climbing, and Jesse and I donate $1,000 to each of their charities. It’s super emotional and ends in a giant slumber party … did I mention at least 10% of these people d’md my hubby, and did I mention I went away on a two day business trip and my husband had king and queen bunk beds installed in every room in the house …. (Because one can never have enough beds for strangers turned friends 😂.) Anyway, it ends with at least 50/80 people spending the night (blow up mattresses, couches, bunk beds, the yard, RV’s in the driveway.) I’m so proud of all the people who come out to climb this nasty hill for a good cause. My husband rightfully named the event, “Hell on the Hill.” What would you climb for? 
#Entrepreneur #Charity
#HellOnTheHill

latestIgtvVideos.title: Asking the question WHY is so important
latestIgtvVideos.caption: Over the years,  people have asked me... "what's your secret?" THIS right here is a huge part of it. I had the guts to ask a super simple question, "Why?" When manufacturers told me we couldn't create a more comfortable waistband in pantyhose I asked, "why?" When people told me business was war... I asked “why?" When people told me that you have to act serious to be taken seriously... "why?" When you have the courage to question and challenge the status quo, a whole new world of possibilities appears. It's the jumping off point for innovation. Afterall... we all come into the world asking,"Why?" Incessantly! WHY (ha, no pun intended) do we stop when we become adults? Because we don't want to feel like we don't have all the answers. But sometimes the same old answer is the very thing you need to question... 💡#TBT #Innovation #Why #Entrepreneur #Business

latestIgtvVideos.title: Sunshine Shorts are BACK! ☀️
latestIgtvVideos.caption: Closet Confession time!!! Have you ever had a pair of shorts you LOVE? Yeah, me niether... 🤷‍♀️ Sunshine Shorts by @Spanx are baaack! ☀️☀️☀️ One year ago we launched them and they sold out in 5 days. We finally have them back and also in some new prints/colors. 💥💥Everything we make at Spanx begins with solving a problem. We ask ourselves, "why doesn't this exist?" or "how can we make this better?" I grew up in Florida on a beach and my “fashion sense” was mostly just cut-off shorts and flip flops. Shorts have always been a mainstay in my wardrobe but most of them were always too short, too long, too tight, really boring OR got wet and took forever to dry. After I became a Mom, the instant a child sits in my lap after the pool I have to explain the dreaded “wet crotch” all day. 😳 So… we rewrote the playbook on shorts and designed a pair you’ll love. ❤️They’re super flattering, made with the perfect body-skimming fabric, they're quick drying and we brought them back this summer in all kinds of NEW and fun patterns and colors. They come in 3 different inseam lengths because we know you love options! I’m wearing the 4” inseam and there is also a 6” and 10” inseam available all on Spanx.com!! Check out the link in my bio. 👍 #Hurry #Sunshine #Shorts #Fashion #Style #Spanx #ClosetConfessions #Entrepreneur #Summer

latestPosts.caption:
Today is American Business Women’s Day, and I keep thinking about how recently women could be required to have a man’s signature to get a business loan.

Some states still required women to have a husband or other male relative co-sign a business loan until 1988?! What?! That was only 12 years before I started @spanx.

The progress came in steps. In 1974, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act made it illegal to deny women credit or require a male co-signer simply because they were women. Then, in 1988, the Women’s Business Ownership Act eliminated state laws requiring a husband or other male relative to co-sign a woman’s business loan - and expanded support for women entrepreneurs.

Not that long ago, a woman’s ability to access credit could depend on a man’s signature instead of her own ambition and ability to build. 🤯

Think of all the businesses, ideas, and inventions that may not have had the chance to exist before then.

I’m a big believer that the more women-owned businesses we have in this world, the better. ❤️

Tag a woman whose business you’re so glad exists. ⬇️ 

#AmericanBusinessWomensDay #WomenOwnedBusiness #FemaleEntrepreneur

Nothing will matter more than your opinion of yourself. Do things that make you proud, be kind, crack yourself up, help others, try new things, manage negative self talk, give yourself a break, become self aware, become a student of yourself, you are fascinating (believe me we all are), spend time alone, take yourself on vacation. If you are chasing approval from others just know their approval often has nothing to do with you (same with their dislike). It’s something you can’t control. It’s affected by the baggage they’re carrying, or the lens they’ve created through their own unique experiences. When you realize what others think of you has almost nothing to do with you, it will free you up to focus on the thing that really matters… do you like you? That’s where you should spend your energy. 😘
